heal_pokemon_at_counter.description: Initiates and completes the healing dialogue with Nurse Joy at the counter, ensuring no automatic B presses cancel the menu. Prints the button sequence.
heal_pokemon_at_counter.python_script:
import json

# Precise button sequence to talk to Nurse Joy and complete healing:
# 1. Press A to talk
# 2. Sleep 1500ms for "Welcome..."
# 3. Press A to advance
# 4. Sleep 1500ms for "We heal..."
# 5. Press A to advance
# 6. Sleep 1500ms for "Shall we heal..." and HEAL/CANCEL menu to appear
# 7. Press A to select HEAL
# 8. Sleep 5500ms for the healing animation and jingle
# 9. Press A to advance "Thank you..."
# 10. Sleep 1500ms for "We hope..."
# 11. Press A to finish conversation
# 12. Sleep 1000ms to exit text box

buttons = [
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A",
    "sleep 5500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1000"
]

print(json.dumps(buttons))

navigate_overworld.description: Plans and generates a sequence of overworld movement button presses using BFS to navigate safely, treating Row 7 south-facing ledge tiles (TYPE_44f6) on Route 25 (excluding Column 9) as solid obstacles when attempting to move North, and respecting building/tree/fence collisions in Cerulean City (Map 0_3) and Vermilion City (Map 0_5). Includes correct Row 28 tree barrier (columns 21-35), Row 19 ledges (columns 32-34) as solid for North, solid signpost obstacles, Column 35 fence (Rows 20-27), Row 33 barrier (Columns 32-38), Column 38 wall (Rows 19-33) in Map 0_3, and Vermilion City major building blockages, water channels, and southern pier boundaries in Map 0_5.
navigate_overworld.python_script:
import sys
import json
from collections import deque

def solve():
    map_id = input_data.get('map_id')
    start_x = int(input_data.get('start_x'))
    start_y = int(input_data.get('start_y'))
    target_x = int(input_data.get('target_x'))
    target_y = int(input_data.get('target_y'))

    obstacles = set()
    
    # Route 24 Nugget Bridge Defeated Trainers
    if map_id == '0_35':
        obstacles.add((11, 31))
        obstacles.add((10, 28))
        obstacles.add((11, 25))
        obstacles.add((10, 22))
        obstacles.add((11, 19))
        obstacles.add((11, 15))
        
    # Route 25 Defeated Trainers
    elif map_id == '0_36':
        obstacles.add((8, 4))
        obstacles.add((14, 3))
        obstacles.add((18, 5))
        obstacles.add((18, 8))
        obstacles.add((23, 9))
        obstacles.add((24, 6))
        obstacles.add((32, 3))
        obstacles.add((37, 4))
        
    # Cerulean City Solid Boundaries and Buildings
    elif map_id == '0_3':
        # Poké Mart Building (X: 24-27, Y: 24-25). Door at (25, 25) is passable.
        obstacles.add((24, 24))
        obstacles.add((25, 24))
        obstacles.add((26, 24))
        obstacles.add((27, 24))
        obstacles.add((24, 25))
        obstacles.add((26, 25))
        obstacles.add((27, 25))
        
        # Blue Building (Left) (X: 18-23, Y: 24-25)
        for x in range(18, 24):
            obstacles.add((x, 24))
            obstacles.add((x, 25))
            
        # Blue Building (Right) (X: 28-30, Y: 24-25)
        for x in range(28, 31):
            obstacles.add((x, 24))
            obstacles.add((x, 25))
            
        # In-Game Trade House (X: 12-17, Y: 14-15). Door at (13, 15) is passable.
        for x in range(12, 18):
            obstacles.add((x, 14))
            if x != 13:
                obstacles.add((x, 15))
                
        # Badge Describer's House (X: 8-12, Y: 10-11). Door at (9, 11) is passable.
        for x in range(8, 13):
            obstacles.add((x, 10))
            if x != 9:
                obstacles.add((x, 11))
                
        # Tree Barrier at Row 28 (X: 21-35, Y: 28)
        for x in range(21, 36):
            obstacles.add((x, 28))
            
        # Cuttable Bush at (19, 28)
        obstacles.add((19, 28))
        
        # Solid Signposts in Cerulean City
        obstacles.add((17, 29))
        obstacles.add((16, 29))
        obstacles.add((23, 19)) # Signpost near Gym
        obstacles.add((27, 21)) # Signpost / Mailbox near Poké Mart alley
        
        # Pokémon Center (X: 18-21, Y: 16-17). Door at (19, 17) is passable.
        obstacles.add((18, 16))
        obstacles.add((19, 16))
        obstacles.add((20, 16))
        obstacles.add((21, 16))
        obstacles.add((18, 17))
        obstacles.add((20, 17))
        obstacles.add((21, 17))
        
        # Cerulean Gym (X: 29-31, Y: 18-19). Door at (30, 19) is passable.
        obstacles.add((29, 18))
        obstacles.add((30, 18))
        obstacles.add((31, 18))
        obstacles.add((29, 19))
        obstacles.add((31, 19))

        # Solid Fence at Column 35 (Y: 20-27)
        for y in range(20, 28):
            obstacles.add((35, y))

        # Solid Mountain Wall at Column 38 (Y: 19-33)
        for y in range(19, 34):
            obstacles.add((38, y))

        # Solid Mountain Wall at Row 33 (X: 32-38, Y: 33)
        for x in range(32, 39):
            obstacles.add((x, 33))

    # Vermilion City (Map 0_5) Obstacles and Buildings
    elif map_id == '0_5':
        # Poké Mart Building: X: 21-24, Y: 12-13. Door at (23, 13) is passable.
        for x in range(21, 25):
            for y in range(12, 14):
                if not (x == 23 and y == 13):
                    obstacles.add((x, y))
                    
        # Fishing Guru House: X: 13-17, Y: 12-13. Door at (15, 13) is passable. (Column 17 is solid wall on screen)
        for x in range(13, 18):
            for y in range(12, 14):
                if not (x == 15 and y == 13):
                    obstacles.add((x, y))
                    
        # Pokémon Fan Club: X: 8-11, Y: 12-13. Door at (9, 13) is passable.
        for x in range(8, 12):
            for y in range(12, 14):
                if not (x == 9 and y == 13):
                    obstacles.add((x, y))
                    
        # Pokémon Center: X: 9-12, Y: 2-3. Door at (11, 3) is passable.
        for x in range(9, 13):
            for y in range(2, 4):
                if not (x == 11 and y == 3):
                    obstacles.add((x, y))
                    
        # Pidgey House: X: 21-24, Y: 18-19. Door at (23, 19) is passable.
        for x in range(21, 25):
            for y in range(18, 20):
                if not (x == 23 and y == 19):
                    obstacles.add((x, y))
                    
        # Gym Building: X: 8-13, Y: 16-18
        for x in range(8, 14):
            for y in range(16, 19):
                obstacles.add((x, y))
            
        # Western blocked fence corridor at Row 19 (making columns 6 & 7 blocked for going north)
        for y in range(12, 20):
            obstacles.add((6, y))
            obstacles.add((7, y))
            
        # Water channels on Column 7 (Rows 10-11)
        obstacles.add((7, 10))
        obstacles.add((7, 11))
        # (7, 13) is a solid obstacle / post
        obstacles.add((7, 13))
        
        # Water channels on Columns 12-13 (Rows 10-11)
        obstacles.add((12, 10))
        obstacles.add((12, 11))
        obstacles.add((13, 10))
        obstacles.add((13, 11))
        
        # Building walls on Row 10 & 11:
        for x in range(8, 12):
            obstacles.add((x, 10))
            obstacles.add((x, 11))
        for x in range(14, 18): # Columns 14-17 are solid walls on Rows 10-11
            obstacles.add((x, 10))
            obstacles.add((x, 11))

    max_x, max_y = 40, 40

    def is_valid_move(x, y, nx, ny, direction):
        if nx < 0 or nx >= max_x or ny < 0 or ny >= max_y:
            return False
        if (nx, ny) in obstacles:
            return False
            
        # Cerulean City Ledge Collision Rules
        if map_id == '0_3':
            if direction == 'Up':
                # Row 17 has south-facing ledges at Columns 9-11 and Columns 22-39
                if ny == 17 and (22 <= nx <= 39 or 9 <= nx <= 11):
                    return False
                # Row 15 has south-facing ledges at Columns 9-11
                if ny == 15 and 9 <= nx <= 11:
                    return False
                # Row 19 has south-facing ledges at Columns 32-34
                if ny == 19 and 32 <= nx <= 34:
                    return False

        # Route 25 Ledge Collision Rules
        if map_id == '0_36':
            if ny == 7 and nx != 9 and direction == 'Up':
                return False
            if y == 8 and ny == 7 and nx != 9 and direction == 'Up':
                return False
            # Northern brick wall on Route 25 at Rows 1-3
            if ny <= 3 and (nx <= 7 or nx >= 9):
                if ny < 4:
                    return False

        # Vermilion City (Map 0_5) Water/Pier boundary rules
        if map_id == '0_5':
            if ny >= 16:
                # Must be on horizontal pier or vertical pier, or Gym building area
                is_on_horiz = (18 <= nx <= 31) and (26 <= ny <= 27)
                is_on_vert = (30 <= nx <= 31) and (16 <= ny <= 25)
                is_on_gym = (8 <= nx <= 13) and (16 <= ny <= 18)
                if not (is_on_horiz or is_on_vert or is_on_gym):
                    return False

        return True

    # BFS queue of (x, y, path)
    queue = deque([(start_x, start_y, [])])
    visited = {(start_x, start_y)}

    moves = [
        ('Up', 0, -1),
        ('Down', 0, 1),
        ('Left', -1, 0),
        ('Right', 1, 0)
    ]

    path_found = None
    while queue:
        cx, cy, path = queue.popleft()
        if cx == target_x and cy == target_y:
            path_found = path
            break

        for direction, dx, dy in moves:
            nx, ny = cx + dx, cy + dy
            if (nx, ny) not in visited:
                if is_valid_move(cx, cy, nx, ny, direction):
                    visited.add((nx, ny))
                    queue.append((nx, ny, path + [direction]))

    if path_found is not None:
        print(json.dumps(path_found))
    else:
        print(json.dumps([]))

solve()

history.commit_message: Initial definition of the navigate_overworld custom tool.
Corrected tool parameter input mechanism to read from pre-injected input_data global variable instead of sys.stdin.
Redefined navigate_overworld tool to correctly account for solid structures in Cerulean City and the Nugget Bridge layout, preventing collisions.
Updated navigate_overworld is_passable logic to strictly restrict Route 24 bridge corridor (Rows 10-34) to Columns 10 and 11, preventing collisions with side walls and water.
Added solid coordinates for the northern blue-roofed building in Cerulean City to prevent collision-induced aborts when navigating north/south.

Exhaustively updated navigate_overworld custom tool SOLID_COORDINATES to include Pokémon Center walls, Trade House walls, the solid brick wall block at (24, 18), and the water pool in Cerulean City, preventing collision aborts.
Redefine navigate_overworld to correctly treat Route 25's Row 7 south-facing ledge tiles (excluding Column 9) as solid obstacles when moving North, preventing invalid pathing attempts.
Update navigate_overworld to incorporate Cerulean City solid building coordinates and barriers.
Update navigate_overworld to include the In-Game Trade House and Badge Describer's House coordinates.
Permanently update navigate_overworld to treat Cerulean City south-facing ledges at Row 17 (Col 9-11, 22-39) and Row 15 (Col 9-11) as solid obstacles when moving North.
Correct Trade House coordinates to X: 12-17, Y: 14-15 in navigate_overworld.
Update navigate_overworld obstacle model for Map 0_3 (Cerulean City) to include columns 31-35 on Row 28 and solid signposts at (23, 19) and (27, 21).
Redefine navigate_overworld to incorporate the south-facing ledges on Row 19 (Columns 32-34) as solid obstacles when moving North in Cerulean City.
Update navigate_overworld to include the Column 38 wall (Rows 19-33), Row 33 wall (Columns 32-38), and Column 35 fence (Rows 20-27) as solid obstacles in Cerulean City.
Refined navigate_overworld custom tool to include Map 0_5 (Vermilion City) obstacle data and water/pier boundary rules to fix the previous pathfinding failure.
Redefined navigate_overworld to include all Vermilion City obstacles, water channels, and walls, ensuring perfect overworld pathfinding on Map 0_5.

Updated navigate_overworld custom tool's Vermilion City (Map 0_5) obstacles to include Column 17 as part of the Fishing Guru house, fixing the pathfinding bug on Column 17 as requested by the overwatch tool critique.
